podcast.title: Bowie's Genre Shifting
podcast.body: David Bowie experimented with industrial rock, showcasing his versatility and "chameleon" nature by adopting diverse styles throughout his career, including glam, disco, and synth pop. His continuous genre-shifting was a key aspect of his artistic identity and commercial strategy. "trying on styles from glam... ...to disco... ...synth pop... ...to industrial rock..."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Importance of Swans and Sonic Youth
podcast.body: A crucial part of the sound and guitar sounds of industrial rock, along with other later rock movements, derives directly from Swans, Sonic Youth, and other No Wave bands. "una parte importantísima de su no dio de sus sonidos de guitarra son su ans sonichuth y son todas estas bandas."

srcs.episode: Qué es el NO WAVE. Es mucho más que música

podcast.title: Influence from Ian Curtis and Joy Division
podcast.body: In the 1990s, a significant wave of bands in industrial rock, notably Nine Inch Nails, drew heavy inspiration from Ian Curtis and Joy Division. "En los 90 tuvimos una leada muy importante inspirada en Joy Division, pues Nine in Chinese en todo el rock industrial se inspiró mucho en lo que fue en Cortes y Joy Division."

srcs.episode: Especial JOY DIVISION: 4. La banda tras el final

podcast.title: Influenced by No Wave
podcast.body: Industrial rock cannot be fully understood without grasping the No Wave movement's reinterpretation of rhythm, which was often based on noise and distortion. "No podemos entender el granch, no podemos entender el subeis, no podemos entender el trimpob, no podemos entender a my bloody Valentine, no podemos entender al rock industrial, sin entender esa manera, de entender el ritmo casi basada en el ruido y en la distorsión."

srcs.episode: Qué es el NO WAVE. Es mucho más que música

podcast.title: Marilyn Manson's Shift Towards Industrial Rock
podcast.body: With "Antichrist Superstar," Marilyn Manson significantly incorporated industrial rock sounds, inspired by Nine Inch Nails, marking a departure from his earlier intense hard rock/dark metal style. "Mey Manson se adentra más en sonidos, pues a lo mejor del rock industrial de Nine Inch Nays."

srcs.episode: Cómo Marilyn Manson revolucionó el mundo con Antichrist Superstar

podcast.title: Updated Sound
podcast.body: Long Distance Calling's album *SuperName* is noted for blending industrial rock with electronics, creating an updated sound likened to Nine Inch Nails. "la parte más industrial del rock mezcla con la electrónica, el mejor rollo Nine In Chinels pero mucho más actualizado."
